tools.name: upload_url
tools.description: If you have the zip, PUT putUrl yourself (max 3MB). Do not put zip in chat. Only send dropUrl to the human if you have no file.

tools.name: scan
tools.description: Check an uploaded zip for unsafe files WITHOUT deploying anything. Free, never 402, burns no preview quota — use this while iterating on the zip (scan → fix → upload_url again → scan). When the content is clean and the human wants to SEE it, call inspect to deploy a throwaway preview Worker. Verdict

tools.name: inspect
tools.description: Deploys a throwaway preview Worker at preview-*.worldsite.workers.dev (not publish.sornkan.com) after scanning the zip. This is the DEPLOY step — it counts against the free preview quota (first 3/day, then $0.10). The 4th+ can be paid two ways: sign the x402 retry with USDC on Base, or show the 402’

tools.name: preview_status
tools.description: Read remaining preview time. uploadId is the UUID (a preview URL is OK). Does not scan, does not reset the clock, never 402. If claimable is false, the preview was deleted — call upload_url, PUT a new zip, inspect, then claim. Do not inspect or claim the old id. Do not pay. Use this instead of inspe

tools.name: claim
tools.description: Go live. $1 USDC first 30 days. Call preview_status first — if claimable is false, do not pay. Ask which slug they want before paying. Live URL is {slug}.worldsite.workers.dev — not {slug}.workers.dev. Pretty names: CNAME their domain after claim. uploadId MUST be the UUID from inspect (not previewU

tools.name: renew
tools.description: Renew hosting +30 days for $1 USDC. Same claiming wallet only. Allowed only while the site is live and remaining < 90 days (stacked cap 90). After expiry renew is unavailable — claim again as a new site; last day without renew means the site is deleted and the slug is free. Support: contact@sornkan.

tools.name: connect_custom_hostname
tools.description: Connect an existing hostname via CNAME to sites.sornkan.com (no registrar). One-time $1 USDC, same claiming wallet, while lease is live. tools.name: render_page
tools.description: Render any public URL in a real browser (Chromium). Returns markdown text, a screenshot URL, and a human-checkable evidence page URL. $0.005 per call. No signup, no API key. x402 wallet required. Pass fullPage:true for the entire scrollable page (same price).

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "publish_website" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: publish_website, preview_status, claim · Private data: publish_website, upload_url, scan, claim, renew, connect_custom_hostname, edit, render_page · Public sink: publish_website, upload_url, inspect, claim · Destructive: preview_status.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: publish_website, preview_status, claim · Private data: publish_website, upload_url, scan, claim, renew, connect_custom_hostname, edit, render_page · Public sink: publish_website, upload_url, inspect, claim · Destructive: preview_status

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
